title: Tesla reportedly might sell its China business ahead of a SpaceX merger | TechCrunch
summary: Tesla is reportedly considering cleaving off its entire business in China to grease the wheels of a merger with SpaceX, according to the Wall Street Journal. That would also be a major concession.
